exact_native_failure_branch.meaning: All current schema/path guards passed, but no native full-decoder logits body exists behind the runner surface.

implemented_this_step.summary: Hardened the host producer contract and native manifest guard so a metadata-only decoder manifest cannot reach the ambiguous terminal full_decoder_logits_generation_not_implemented branch.
implemented_this_step.behavioral_change: Current exporter manifests that lack runtime-driving fields now fail closed with decoder_manifest_architecture_config_missing and decoder_manifest_tensor_role_inventory_missing before native invocation or inside native guard, depending entrypoint.
implemented_this_step.why_not_full_runtime: The existing exported polymath_c5_full_decoder_manifest_v1 describes source model identity and coarse layer inventory but does not provide the architecture_config and tensor_role_inventory needed for native code to map safetensors tensors into attention, MLP, norm, RoPE, adapter, and LM-head roles. The C++ tree also has no safetensors-backed full decoder runtime body yet.
implemented_this_step.raw_boundary: No raw QA, checkpoint, adapter, model, tensor, prediction, or logits payloads were copied into git reports.

integrations/gemma4-snapdragon-megakerne.role: Native C5 manifest guard now requires layer_inventory, source_model_safetensors, architecture_config, and tensor_role_inventory before terminal logits body dispatch.

scripts/host/run_c5_phase34_qa_inference.role: Host producer contract and pre-native validator now require runtime-driving decoder manifest fields and source model identity.

tests/test_c5_phase34_qa_inference_produ.role: Regression coverage for metadata-only manifest rejection and updated valid-manifest fixtures.

tensor_role_inventory_minimum_semantics: per-layer q_proj/k_proj/v_proj/o_proj tensor key, dtype, shape, and byte range
per-layer gate_proj/up_proj/down_proj tensor key, dtype, shape, and byte range
per-layer input/post-attention norm tensor key, dtype, shape, and byte range
LM-head/unembedding tied or separate tensor key, dtype, shape, and byte range
token embedding tensor key, dtype, shape, and byte range

files_to_add_or_modify.purpose: Declare bounded safetensors header parsing, SHA validation, tensor metadata lookup, and range-read interfaces.
Implement stdlib-only safetensors metadata and tensor range reader; never emit tensor bytes to reports.
Expose the native full-decoder C5 QA runtime contract for prediction JSONL rows and compact telemetry.
Implement streamed/chunked Gemma 4 E4B decoder execution, answer-token NLL, confidence, and greedy prediction without full B*S*V logits materialization.
Replace only the terminal full_decoder_logits_generation_not_implemented branch with a call into c5_full_decoder_runtime after existing guards pass.
Link safetensors_reader.cpp and c5_full_decoder_runtime.cpp into gemma4_megakernel_core.
Exercise safetensors metadata parsing, schema/path/SHA failure surfaces, adapter SHA binding, vocab chunk bounds, and prediction JSONL contract.

runtime_algorithm_contract: Load and validate tokenizer identity, decoder manifest, adapter policy, candidate/stable adapter SHA, heldout QA SHA, and output path boundary.
Open source_model_safetensors through a bounded reader and verify manifest SHA/size before any tensor role lookup.
Map tensor_role_inventory entries into the decoder layer loop; reject missing/unsupported dtype/shape/range before execution.
Run prompt prefill plus answer teacher forcing through all 42 layers using bounded memory and the configured max_generation_tokens.
Apply the rank-16 Phase4 adapter only at the adapter_site_policy layer/site and only for the checkpoint role being evaluated.
Project logits in chunks no larger than --vocab-chunk-size; compute per-answer-token NLL, perplexity input, and confidence without materializing full B*S*V logits.
Emit outside-git JSONL rows with record_id, prediction, finite nonnegative loss, and confidence in [0,1].

reproduction_command.description: After Custodian freezes this pathset and Execution rebuilds/copies the runner, rerun the same C5_after_C1 candidate native probe. With the current metadata-only component pack, expected first_missing_green_field advances from full_decoder_logits_generation_not_implemented to decoder_manifest_architecture_config_missing. With a schema-complete pack but no runtime body, expected stop is the terminal runtime-body missing failure until c5_full_decoder_runtime.cpp lands.

next_action: Repo Custodian freezes the three-file contract/guard/test patch. Engineering exporter must emit architecture_config and tensor_role_inventory in the outside-git component pack. Phase3/4 then lands safetensors_reader plus c5_full_decoder_runtime and replaces the terminal full_decoder_logits_generation_not_implemented branch.
